Manhattan Active SCALE Documentation
        Print Default Documents Web Service
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
    
    
    
        This web service allows printing of default documents.


     Request



    
        URI: http://ServerName/general/paperwork/defaultDocuments-Printed

        Method:POST

        Accept: application/json or application/xml

        Roles: SCALEUSER
    



     Response



    Aside from standard responses, note the following specifics for this service:

    

    
        
            
                Status Code

                Notes
            

            
                200

                
                    OK will be accompanied by an entity conforming to one of the requested media types: application/vnd.manh.ils.paperwork.printRequest+json

                    
                
            

            
                400

                The following Error Type can be expected: Unknown
